announcements.headline: Results of AGM

announcements.headline: FINAL RESULTS FOR THE YEAR ENDED 31 MARCH 2026
announcements.insight: As a pre-revenue SPAC with no operating history, the release of final results serves primarily as a compliance milestone rather than a value driver; the market will focus on cash runway and the timeline for any potential de-SPAC transaction or liquidation.
